text: Company Profile Calisto Group We are a collective of forward thinking retailers based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Driven by creativity and a commitment to excellence, we constantly challenge conventions, reimagining retail with fresh perspectives and meaningful innovation. Whether through curated selections, original brand development, or evolving retail concepts, we aim to shape a future within ourself where retail is not just transactional, but transformational. Founded in 2022, CALISTO curates a selection of designer eyewear brands, complemented by comprehensive services. With a vision to redefine the eyewear experience, CALISTO connects customers both online and offline through a seamless omnichannel retail approach.

Our upcoming website, www.calisto.co, will soon introduce a new kind of shopping experience blending style, service, and simplicity in one accessible platform. As we prepare to launch our own signature eyewear line CALISTO, we’re also reimagining our retail concept to reflect a more design-forward and customer-centric philosophy. This includes a fresh approach to interior design, featuring minimalist aesthetics, and thoughtfully crafted spaces that enhance both product discovery and personal service. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) Q1. What is Calisto? A: Calisto is a Malaysian eyewear and vision care retailer offering designer glasses, contact lenses, and professional eye care services. Q2. What makes Calisto different from other eyewear stores? A: Calisto combines fashion-forward eyewear with professional clinical optometry services, supported by advanced eye testing technology across our boutiques. Q3. Can I book an eye test online? A: Yes, you can conveniently book an eye examination appointment through our online booking portal: https://client.calisto.co/home Q4. Do you offer adjustments or after-sales care? A: Yes, customers may visit our boutiques for frame adjustments and fitting

advice as part of our after-sales support services. Q5. Where are Calisto stores located? A: Calisto operates multiple physical outlets across Malaysia, including Calisto Vision Care boutiques and sub-brands such as Myangkasa Optikal and Omni Eyewear. You may refer to our store locator for the full list of locations: https://calisto.co/stores
